Name: Hidden Food Retextured
Author: pmgin
Description:
[size=4][b]What does this mod do? [/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod replaces some hidden/unused food items from the game's files. It doesn't do much itself, but if you happen to use any mod that uses the same sprites directly from Maps/springobjects.png (such as Animal Husbandry Mod), textures will be replaced with my version.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]SMAPI & Content Patcher [/b]are the only hard requirements BUT, as I already mentioned, this mod is dedicated to being used with [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry Mod[/url][/b].[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]How to install[/b][/size][/color][color=#D4D4D8]
Make sure that you installed SMAPI and Content Patcher. Download and unzip folder from "download" section.
Drop unzipped folder to your "Mods" folder.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b][size=4]Config[/size][/b]
This mod has a config file where you can disable it with [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10505]GMCM Options[/url].[/b][/color]

[b][size=4]Conflicts[/size][/b]
This mod [i]may[/i] conflict with any mod that targets Maps/springobjects.png texture. If you encounter any issues, please report them.

[b][size=4]Credits[/size][/b]
[size=3]ConcernedApe for original textures :)[/size]
